release_notes: 1-Click TikTok for Business integration: OAuth login from the Pixel Vault discovers every ad account and pixel on the fly, imports the pixels into the vault and sets up automatic spend sync per selected cabinet — TikTok's ~24h access tokens are refreshed automatically by the scheduled cost sync, and the fresh token propagates to the imported pixels. The Pixel Vault gains source filter tabs (Facebook / TikTok / Google Ads…) with live counts, pixel options in the campaign editor now spell out their network, and a ready-made TikTok Pixel snippet for landings passes the pixel id through the {pixel} campaign parameter via cookie. Fixes: the Campaigns white screen shipped in 1.0.0 (TDZ on the traffic-source filter state), softer active-card glow with breathing room above Traffic Dynamics on the dashboard, and a clearer search input on the Traffic Sources page.
